slides.label: Multiple breakpoints
slides.source_text: Optional reference · Back to the talk In practice Place breakpoints around real reuse Mark stable boundaries that requests actually share. A later change can preserve an earlier cached entry if a write exists there. Do not assume lookup creates earlier entries that were never written. See the current lookup and breakpoint limits.
